D2.descr: BAT54SW,115 dual series Schottky, SOT-323/SC-70. Vendor land via easyeda2kicad C78606; courtyard widened from the body-only box to cover the pads (place.py's relaxer/audit and DRC all reason about courtyards). Pin 1 = anode(D1), 2 = cathode(D2), 3 = cathode1+anode2 midpoint (Nexperia BAT54W-series ds Rev.3 Table 2).

D3.descr: SOD-323 two-lead diode (KiCad Diode_SMD stock land). Pad 1 = CATHODE (the F.Fab bar sits on the pad-1 side, triangle apex points at it), pad 2 = anode. Used for D3, the VBUS -> VSYS blocking Schottky.

Q2.descr: Generic SOT-323/SC-70 3-lead MOSFET. Land + courtyard reused verbatim from SOT-323_BAT54SW (same JEDEC package, easyeda2kicad vendor land for C78606) so the placement scans that proved SC-70 fits this board still apply. Pin 1 = gate, 2 = source, 3 = drain — the universal 3-lead SOT-23/SOT-323 MOSFET convention, confirmed for CJ2101 (P-ch) and BSS138W (N-ch).
